blocks.text: DETROIT — Austin Reaves thought he had a very fortunate night against the Detroit Pistons. He was the only one in the Los Angeles Lakers locker room who thought so. On a night when the Lakers were playing without red-hot Luka Doncic, Reaves scored 43 points against one of the league’s best defenses in a 121-116 win. “I was a lucky basketball player tonight,” said Reaves, who went 14 of 27 from the floor, including 4 of 6 on 3-pointers, and added a perfect 11-for-11 from the free-throw line.
